hero.tagline: I build and automate enterprise cloud infrastructure, CI/CD platforms, and developer tooling that powers 2,000+ engineers across global teams.

about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: AWS DevOps / Platform Engineer with 4+ years of experience building and automating enterprise cloud infrastructure, CI/CD platforms, Infrastructure as Code, and developer tooling.

Hands-on expertise in AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, GitHub Enterprise, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Bash, Python, and Datadog. Proven track record of automating cloud infrastructure and CI/CD processes, improving developer productivity, optimizing cloud costs, and supporting enterprise engineering platforms.

Architected a hybrid ECR distribution strategy combining Cross-Region Replication and Pull-Through Cache across 7 global AWS regions, reducing multi-region storage and data transfer costs by 90%+ and generating $163,884 in annualized infrastructure savings.
about.quote: Building reliable engineering platforms that empower developers to ship faster.

projects.heading: Selected Work
projects.description: A selection of projects that showcase my work in platform engineering, infrastructure automation, and developer productivity.

items.title: ECR Hybrid Image Distribution
items.description: Architecting a hybrid ECR distribution strategy combining Cross-Region Replication and Pull-Through Cache across 7 global AWS regions — reducing 5GB image pull times from ~7m49s to ~2m57s and generating $163K in annualized savings.

items.title: GitHub Enterprise Governance
items.description: Building automation for GitHub Enterprise Cloud at scale — org-level secrets management, third-party Action allowlisting, repository governance via identity platform, and a Python CLI toolkit for member/hooks/SSO/identity operations.

items.title: Self-Hosted Runner Platform
items.description: An autoscaled, ephemeral runner fleet on AWS — a Python autoscaler consuming GitHub webhooks, instance orchestrators managing runner lifecycle, resource monitors, Packer-built AMIs, and Terraform infrastructure.

items.title: CI/CD Observability Stack
items.description: A Python webhook ingestion service that turns GitHub Actions events into Datadog metrics, plus Terraform-managed monitors, dashboards, and SLOs for platform health — reducing MTTR by 40%.
